outcome: Cesarean section due to fetal distress
cohort: 66 pregnant women with hypertension (21 with CHT and 45 with GHT)
finding: Alterations in fetal renal volume and vascularization, particularly depressed vascularization of the medullae, are associated with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, including cesarean section, perinatal infection, NICU admission, and perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: The study found a correlation between altered fetal renal vascularization and a higher rate of cesarean section due to fetal distress.
